name: imagedrip
description: Generate image batches by driving your own logged-in ChatGPT session — no paid image API.
_packageManager_why: This repo is npm-only — package-lock.json is the committed lockfile. Declared so npm/pnpm/yarn refuse the wrong tool instead of half-installing: pnpm 10+ blocks postinstall by default, and Electron's postinstall is what downloads the Electron binary, so `pnpm install` yields a package with no Electron in it. See docs/kdd/learnings/blocked-postinstall-leaves-a-hollow-package.md
author: David Cruwys

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
